on CreateTheBlob2
local tBlobID, tData, tDesktopPath, tTempPath, tValue, tWavData
 
--READ FILE FROM DESKTOP
put specialFolderPath("desktop") & "/wave_sample.wav" into tDesktopPath
put url("binfile:" & tDesktopPath) into tData
 
--SAVE RAW FILE IN TEMPORARY FOLDER
put the temporary folder & "/wave_sample.wav" into tTempPath
put tData into url("binfile:" & tTempPath)
 
--CREATE BLOB IN STANDARD LOCATION
put cdb_createBlob(tTempPath,"local") into tBlobID
 
--DECRYPT BLOB IN STANDARD LOCATION
put cdb_readBlob(tBlobID,"local") into tValue
 
--MAKE A COPY ON THE DESKTOP FOR TESTING
--put url("binfile:" & tValue) into tWavData

--put tWav into url("binfile:" & tDesktopPath)
end CreateTheBlob2
